verdict.rationale: Greptile ships a documented, npm-installable official CLI (`greptile onboard`, `greptile review`) confirmed working at runtime (npx greptile --version returned 3.5.2 keylessly), with docs explicitly framing it for agentic use ('coding agents can use the greptile cli to review their own code') and 60-second scriptable reviews. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of CLI usage specifically (only official docs and probes).
